decision: dark stage: setEnvMapBackground(false) plus setBackgroundColor(10,10,10) on viewer ready and again on model loaded, theme=dark on APSViewer; overlays need z-10 because the LMV canvas stacks above siblings
why: the AEC profile re-lights the environment when a model lands, so one call on ready was not enough; the legend was invisible until the z-index fix (probed with elementsFromPoint)
evidence: verify: envMapBackground false, clearColorTop [10,10,10], legend contains the top element at its corner
